title: Mixed Duo #21
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: Nigerian, in her early 40s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, long braids piled into a high sculpted crown, a bright, joyful smile, twin-tail hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 segment rings piercings set with opals in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of rose-gold earrings. Painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern, a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide silver bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands on her own hips, elbows held wide, confident direct gaze, extreme silver extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her mid 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, huge voluminous light-brown curls with a big pink satin bow, a sweet princess-like smile, curly hair, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of mixed-metal an anklet. Painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic, a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide ochre bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, extreme ochre extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
